recipes.title: Sheet Pan Roast Chicken & Vegetables
recipes.description: Quick chicken breasts with potatoes, carrots, one-pan simplicity.
instructions: Cut 500g potatoes into 3cm chunks and slice 400g carrots diagonally into 2cm pieces.
Mince 4 garlic cloves and chop 2 tbsp fresh thyme leaves.
Distribute potatoes and carrots across a large sheet pan, drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with minced garlic, thyme, ½ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp black pepper, then toss to coat evenly.
Roast vegetables at 200°C for 15 minutes to soften slightly.
Pat 4 × 180g chicken breasts dry with paper towels, rub with remaining 2 tbsp olive oil, season with remaining ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper.
Remove pan from oven and nestle seasoned chicken breasts among vegetables.
Return to 200°C oven and roast for 18–20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender and lightly caramelized.
Rest on the sheet pan for 3 minutes, then serve directly.
